title: Funny Retirement Pickleball Shirt, My Retirement Schedule Pickleball Nap Pickleball, Retiree Gift
description:
A retirement calendar that is refreshingly honest: pickleball, pickleball, nap, pickleball.

Who it's for:
- New retirees heading straight to the courts
- Coworkers and family choosing a retirement party gift
- Anyone whose day is organised around court times

About the design:
A tidy, planner-style schedule in lime and cream with a coral 'NAP' to break it up, ending with 'Nothing else penciled in'.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
